name: Workspace Open and Close Semantics
description: What happens when a workspace opens: file watching, index hydration, project attachment, agent spawning. What happens on close: flush, save, detach, cleanup.
purpose: Workspace boundaries are explicit and safe.
acceptanceCriteria: Workspace open triggers deterministic sequence: file watcher init, index hydration, project attachment, agent pool spawn
Workspace close triggers deterministic sequence: agent drain, project detach, index flush, watcher teardown
Open is idempotent — re-opening an already-open workspace returns existing handle
Close is idempotent — double-close does not throw or corrupt
In-flight operations during close are drained with configurable timeout before force-termination
Workspace open/close events are published to an observable stream
required_evidence: Workspace open deterministic sequence test (watcher → index → project → agents)
Workspace close deterministic sequence test (drain → detach → flush → teardown)
rollback_strategy: Failed workspace open rolls back all partial setup steps in reverse order
recovery_strategy: On crash, detect open workspace records from session and offer recovery or cleanup
escalation_policy: Workspace that cannot open after max attempts escalates to user with diagnostics
